newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers not well established with a lower undertone noted, compared to Friday's close, USDA said.
Trade slow. Demand moderate. Seller interest fairly light. Offerings current. Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs few 66.00-67.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100 lbs pt ld 66.00
